fact: Car 23 allegedly left the track at T1 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 c) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, timing, telemetry in-car video evidence. Car 81 attempted a very late move on Car 23 up the inside into Turn 1, forcing Car 23 off track at the exit. Due to the track layout in that part of the track, Car 23 was able to stay alongside and maintain his position, essentially resulting in both cars ending up in the correct order. Taking all this into account the Stewards decide to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 23 Alleged Leaving The Track
